chateauversailles.name: Palace of Versailles
chateauversailles.slogan: Seventeen hundred gilded years of royal show-off, one mirror at a time.
chateauversailles.line: The Treaty of Versailles ending the First World War was signed in the Hall of Mirrors on 28 June 1919.

chcathedral.name: Chartres Cathedral
chcathedral.slogan: Blue light that has poured through the same glass since 1200.
chcathedral.line: After the fire of 1194, the cathedral, with most of its glass and sculpture, was largely finished within just twenty-five years.

petittrianon.name: Petit Trianon
petittrianon.slogan: Marie-Antoinette's small, quiet escape from the court.
petittrianon.line: Built for Madame de Pompadour, it was given by Louis XVI in 1774 to 19-year-old Marie-Antoinette for her exclusive use.

vcsavoye.name: Villa Savoye
vcsavoye.slogan: A white box on stilts that changed how the world builds.
vcsavoye.line: A house is a machine for living in.

sgchateau.name: Chateau of Saint-Germain-en-Laye
sgchateau.slogan: Where a Sun King was born and prehistory now lives.
sgchateau.line: Louis XIV was born at the Chateau Neuf of Saint-Germain-en-Laye in 1638.
